title: Recording, mixing: The Luck Of The Irish by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

John Lennon and Yoko Ono recorded the Some Time In New York City song ‘The Luck Of The Irish’ on 8 March 1972.

The couple had recorded an acoustic version of the song at their 105 Bank Street apartment earlier in the year, which they had considered releasing, but chose instead to record a full band version with Elephant’s Memory.

The recording was mostly completed during this session, and it was mixed before the end of the night, but strings were added on 18 March and it was remixed the following day.
